name: core
description: Task protocol, handoffs, scope rules, the safety guard and action-journal hooks, the task board (Plane) MCP and the project Q&A server (agent-mcp). Every person and every service agent uses this.

tracker_api_key.title: Task board personal access token
tracker_api_key.description: Your own token on the task board (Plane: Profile settings → Personal access tokens). Never a shared one.

tracker_base_url.title: Task board URL
tracker_base_url.description: Base URL of your Plane instance, e.g. https://plane.example.com

tracker_workspace_slug.title: Task board workspace
tracker_workspace_slug.description: The workspace part of the Plane URL.

agent_mcp_url.title: agent-mcp URL
agent_mcp_url.description: Base URL of your team's agent-mcp server without /mcp, e.g. https://agents.example.com/agent-mcp. Used for project Q&A, teammate messages and the action journal.

role.title: Your role
role.description: One of: product, design, backend, frontend, data, devops. Decides which scope rules apply to you (devops also unlocks running non-production pipelines and CI jobs).
